message:
wolf 0.2.36

C variadics in both directions on hosted Linux x86-64 and the freestanding x86-64 target, VaList and the four va_* operations (s263); the invocation name and byte-exact arguments through env_arg0 and env_args_bytes (s261); the static musl entry hands argc/argv/envp to the runtime (s267, #962); read lends forward the owner's address for exclusive exact-layout single-use aggregates (s264); the start-up regression fixed (s265, #918); the small ones (s266); the three wrong answers t06 replayed (s260); a fifth asset, the musl runtime wolf-rt-0.2.36-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz; paired with lupin 0.1.58; wolf-std at 78b9d3c. r41.
